answer: VDF timing proofs at the submission gate: each identity must solve a sequential delay function taking ~10 min of real wall-clock time, verified instantly by validators. Attacker cost scales linearly in hardware but the glacier of accrued honest chain-time cannot be bought — fresh sybils arrive with zero timing depth. A haven of 51% then requires outspending the entire network's accumulated delay, and any dune of fake identities is detectable by their telltale shallow proof history. Works because time itself is the scarce, non-parallelizable resource no attacker can fake or rush.
